summary.text: John Lovick is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate representing District 44, where he took office on December 15, 2021, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Sherri Larkin.

paragraphs.text: John Lovick served in the U.S. Coast Guard for 13 years, and his career experience includes working as a Washington State Trooper and as the Snohomish County Sheriff.
He served in the Washington House of Representatives from 1999 to 2007 and again from 2016 to 2021, having been appointed to the House on June 8, 2016, to replace Hans Dunshee.
Lovick left the House on December 15, 2021, after being appointed to the state Senate to replace Steve Hobbs.

For 2023-2024 his Senate committee assignments were Business, Financial Services & Trade; Environment, Energy & Technology; Rules; Transportation, where he was vice chair; and the Joint Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
